question: After the unified chat-and-voice foundation lands, should OpenClaw adopt this reference-inspired three-surface iPhone shell as the supported phone navigation model?
rationale: The branch changes the primary iPhone information architecture rather than correcting an established behavior, and its stacked base has not yet become the stable integration target.

options.title: Sponsor after parent lands
options.body: Merge the parent first, then require a rebase and end-to-end state-preservation proof for this shell.

options.title: Keep current phone hierarchy
options.body: Decline the shell direction and retain the existing iPhone navigation model while preserving the parent’s unified Assistant work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after parent lands
recommendation.body: Merge the parent first, then require a rebase and end-to-end state-preservation proof for this shell.

likelyOwner.reason: The open parent branch establishes the Assistant/session ownership contract that this design extends.
